## Summary
Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] UI or accessibility
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security or infrastructure

## Validation
- [ ] `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Tested affected routes
- [ ] No real documents, credentials, or private data added

## Security and data impact
Describe any changes to authentication, authorization, file access, storage, or user data.
